keyDates.text: Common App 2026-27 cycle officially opened. Essay prompts unchanged; 'Activities' section renamed 'Activities and Experiences.' Over 1,100 colleges now on platform.
Inside Higher Ed hosts free webcast on 'Higher Ed's Big Restructuring: Adapting to the Era of the Modern Learner' at 2 p.m. Eastern.
Early Decision/Early Action deadlines at most Ivy League schools. October SAT is last viable test date for ED applicants at test-required schools.
Regular Decision deadlines for most Ivy League and highly selective universities for the Class of 2031.
OBBBA deadline: All existing federal student loan borrowers must transition from legacy IDR plans (SAVE, PAYE, ICR) to new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) or IBR.
Columbia University reinstates standardized testing requirement for first-year and transfer applicants, ending test-optional status for the 2027-28 admission cycle.
Chronicle of Higher Education virtual leadership series for women in academe launches. Higher education sector preparing for fall enrollment amid international student declines.
Chronicle of Higher Education workshop series for administrative leaders on navigating shared governance and institutional decision-making in a volatile environment.
